response.text:
Here are your deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library items** to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt, due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Late fees increase per item per opening day and the account gets blocked once fees reach 10,00 €, per the letter.
- **Object to contribution notice (Widerspruch)** with Muster BKK, due Wed 14 Oct 2026, send by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_v0kx33tjwnwb]. If you don't object in time, the notice becomes final.
- **Tax objection deadline (Einspruchsfrist)** with Finanzamt Musterstadt, due Wed 21 Oct 2026, send by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ddxnhb06rr9h]. If no objection is filed, the assessment becomes final and can't be challenged.

For the two objection deadlines, consider getting advice if you're unsure — you can draft the objection letter in Ordnung.
